authority_boundary.rule: Runtime profiles and food-web links MUST NOT be promoted to canon automatically.

actions.ECO_FORAGE: consume bounded resource and reduce hunger
actions.ECO_DRINK: consume bounded water and reduce thirst
actions.ECO_FLEE: respond to threat with energy cost
actions.ECO_MIGRATE: change territory only after habitat/range validation
actions.ECO_REPRODUCE: validated pair action followed by idempotent runtime-born child materialization

groups.leader_resolution: explicit LEADER role then rank_score then stable runtime ref

territorial_memory.use: migration preference only; does not rewrite canonical distribution

aggregate_ecology.food_web: runtime relation, explicit not inferred from Master
aggregate_ecology.routine_tick: bounded logistic/resource/climate growth plus bounded same-territory predation
aggregate_ecology.offline: ROUTINE_SAFE only; no extraordinary migration/settlement escalation

safety_invariants: No negative individual biological resource caused by a validated ecological decision path.
Same reproduction event materializes at most one child.
Shared resources use optimistic version preconditions; conflicts are safe retry outcomes.
Population routine tick is idempotent by world_instance_id + tick_key.
Integrity failure blocks world through CORRUPT_BLOCKED.
non_goals: No weather engine authored in this stage.
No LLM authority for animal actions.
No canonical diet/aggression inference from missing source data.
